summary: SECOND rigorous end-to-end verification pass (READ-ONLY, no code changes). Ran backend pytest chain (11/11 PASS) + real UI Playwright pass on production URL as school_admin@test.ly + backend surface probing for tenancy and duplication. Confirmed iter-6 CRUD workflows are green (Login, Teacher, Student create, Exam, Schedule, Finance invoice+payment). Discovered THREE previously-unreported issues that are deployment blockers: (1) multi-tenant WRITE isolation is broken: POST /finance/invoices and POST /academic/attendance persist any client-supplied school_id, allowing cross-tenant data planting; (2) attendance POST has no unique index or upsert, so every save-click duplicates rows for the same (student,date) — attendance % will be inflated; (3) Student 360 profile does NOT exist — view-student and edit-student buttons in StudentsPage have no onClick handler. Reports UI shows real backend data but as a raw JSON dump — MAJOR UX gap. Deliverable /app/END_TO_END_ERP_VALIDATION.md written with GO/NO-GO recommendation = NO-GO. No files in /app/backend or /app/frontend modified.

critical.issue: Multi-tenant WRITE isolation broken: client-supplied body.school_id is persisted instead of user's JWT school_id. Verified by planting invoice with school_id=school_OTHER_TENANT_9999 → HTTP 200.
Same tenancy bypass AND no idempotency: multiple POSTs for same (student_id,date) create N duplicate rows (proved 3x). Real UI's per-student save-loop will inflate attendance stats.

minor.issue: 307 redirect on trailing slash (cosmetic, carried over).
Hard cap .to_list(1000) silently truncates for larger schools.
Deleting a Grade/Section does not cascade; orphaned Students/Exams/Attendance possible.

ui_bugs.issue: view-student-{id} button has NO onClick handler (line 435). No Student 360 profile page/dialog exists — explicit product requirement missing.
edit-student-{id} button has NO onClick handler (line 438). Students cannot be edited via UI.
Reports rendered as raw JSON <pre> dump (line 122). No tables/charts. Unusable for end-users.
Section dropdown is not filtered by selected Grade; picking a mismatched pair silently shows 0 students.
Summary cards (present/absent/late/excused counts) observed as 0 even after marking — needs verification that they read from real backend aggregate for the selected class/date.

integration_issues.issue: Sends N parallel POSTs (Promise.all) which duplicate rows on backend; needs bulk endpoint + upsert.

issues: Eye/Edit/Trash2 buttons lack aria-label for screen readers

action_items: [CRITICAL] Server-side override school_id from JWT on every POST/PUT/PATCH (ignore client-supplied school_id in body/query). Audit: invoices, payments, attendance, students, teachers, exams, schedule_periods, grades, sections, rooms, subjects.

[CRITICAL] Add unique compound index on attendance (school_id, student_id, subject_id, date) AND switch POST /academic/attendance to upsert (or provide POST /academic/attendance/bulk that replaces the day).

[CRITICAL] Implement Student 360 profile: wire view-student onClick to open Dialog or route /students/:id with tabs Academic / Attendance / Financial fed by /academic/grades, /academic/attendance, /finance/invoices scoped to student_id.
[HIGH] Wire edit-student onClick to open the existing StudentForm in edit mode.
[HIGH] Rewrite ReportsPage to render real tables/charts for attendance %, grade averages, finance totals, student counts instead of JSON.stringify pre-dump.
[MEDIUM] Filter section dropdown by selected grade in AttendancePage & StudentsPage.
[MEDIUM] Clean residual TEST/UI-prefixed students from production tenant (school_a259442901a0).
[MEDIUM] Add cascade or soft-delete rules to prevent orphaned records when a Grade/Section is deleted.
[LOW] Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to remaining DialogContent for a11y.
[LOW] Use non-trailing-slash routes on frontend to avoid 307 hop for academic/grades and academic/subjects.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: every mutation endpoint accepts Pydantic model with school_id — server must override with user.school_id from JWT, not trust the client. This is a systemic issue, not per-endpoint.
AttendanceCreate does not include an upsert path; a bulk POST endpoint that accepts a list of {student_id,status} for a given date would eliminate N+1 requests and duplicate rows in one shot.
StudentsPage.js: view-student and edit-student buttons ship as inert UI — either remove them until implemented or ship the Student 360 dialog.

ReportsPage.js: 129 lines but no real presentation of data.data — using 
JSON.stringify
is unfit for production ERP consumers.
AttendancePage.js: summary cards computed from unclear source; ensure counts are computed from `attendanceRecords` for the selected class+date (not global today).
No Mongo indexes visible in server.py — recommend creating unique indexes at startup: attendance(student_id,date,subject_id), invoices(invoice_number), users(email).

success_rate.backend: 11/11 pytest chain PASS but 2 CRITICAL production endpoints broken (tenancy+attendance dedup) = 78% weighted
success_rate.frontend: 6/9 workflows fully green; Student 360 missing, Reports UI unusable, Attendance save duplicates = 65%

Focus for the next iteration after main agent fixes: (a) re-run cross-tenant plant curl (should now return 403/400 or persist with server's own school_id), (b) hammer POST /academic/attendance 3x for same student+date and confirm only 1 record exists, (c) UI-verify Student 360 opens with 3 tabs and shows real per-student grades/attendance/invoices, (d) UI-verify Edit student opens dialog pre-filled, (e) UI-verify Reports show tables/charts. Backend chain pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_creation_chain.py still valid — extend with tenancy-negative-test and attendance-idempotency test after fix. NO CODE CHANGES WERE MADE in this iteration.
rca of the issue: CF-1 root cause: create_invoice/record_attendance handlers use `invoice_data.school_id` / `attendance_data.school_id` directly (server.py:1194, 1518) — they trust the request body. Fix: replace with `user['school_id']` from `get_current_user`. CF-2 root cause: `db.attendance.insert_one` at server.py:1528 with no unique key. Fix: create unique index at startup on (school_id, student_id, subject_id, date) and switch to `update_one({...}, {'$set': doc}, upsert=True)`. CF-3 root cause: StudentsPage.js view/edit buttons never received onClick wiring — feature simply not implemented. Fix: add StudentProfileDialog component and setDialogOpen(true) with mode='view'/'edit'.
